name: shared-tooltip
title: Shared Tooltip
description: A row of formatting icons where a single shared tooltip follows the pointer from button to button, sliding and reshaping to show each action's name and keyboard shortcut with an arrow.
use: A dense icon toolbar needs labels on hover, and separate tooltips flickering in and out would feel noisy.
avoid: One shared popup means only one hint shows at a time, so it suits adjacent triggers rather than distant ones.
a11y: Opens on focus as well as hover and links trigger to bubble with aria-describedby; the demo's icons also carry their own labels. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A dark rounded toolbar holds five thin white icons: bold, italic, underline, strikethrough and a link. Above the hovered icon sits a white rounded bubble with dark text and a small downward arrow; the active icon gains a faint grey square behind it.
behaves: Hovering an icon opens the shared tooltip above it after a short delay. Moving to a neighbour makes the same bubble glide sideways, reshaping to the new text and sliding its arrow along, instead of closing and reopening.
customise: Open and close delays and the spring transition are provider props; each tooltip sets its side, offsets and alignment, and the trigger and content are yours to compose.
weight: light: One floating popup and a tiny layout animation; idle until a pointer enters.
demo: Five formatting buttons with tooltips: Bold ⌘B, Italic ⌘I, Underline ⌘U, Strikethrough ⌘⇧X and Insert link ⌘K.
issues: The tooltip text is blurred for much of the glide, so the label is unreadable while it moves.
polishWhy: The glide is smooth and the shortcut hint is clear; the bubble stays blurred for most of the move.
